full_form_body: Andhra Pradesh Engineering, Agriculture and Pharmacy Common Entrance Test - conducted by JNTU Kakinada on behalf of APSCHE (renamed from the old 'EAMCET' name in 2021 once medical seats moved fully to NEET; Telangana's sister exam is still called TS EAMCET)
eligibility: Indian Nationality, PIO, or OCI card holder; must satisfy Andhra Pradesh Local/Non-Local status per AP Government Orders 2026-27; at least 45% marks (40% for reserved category) in the qualifying examination subjects taken together. Intermediate MPC required for Engineering/B.Pharmacy(MPC)/Pharm.D/B.Tech.(Dairy Tech/Agr.Engg/Food Science); Intermediate BiPC for the Agriculture & remaining Pharmacy streams
application_window: Notification 04-02-2026 (Wed); online applications open 04-02-2026. Last date without late fee 24-03-2026 (Tue) - CORRECTS an earlier pending_review entry that had 7 Mar 2026 from secondary trackers; the official V4 booklet supersedes it. Late fee tiers: Rs.1,000 to 28-03-2026, Rs.2,000 to 01-04-2026, Rs.4,000 to 06-04-2026, Rs.10,000 to 10-04-2026. Application-data correction window 11-04-2026 to 13-04-2026. Hall tickets from 28-04-2026
exam_date: Engineering: 12-05-2026 to 18-05-2026, two sessions/day (09:00AM-12:00PM and 02:00-05:00PM), no sessions on 16th/17th May. Agriculture & Pharmacy: 19-05-2026 to 20-05-2026. Preliminary key 23-05-2026; objection deadline 25-05-2026 (Rs.300/objection, refundable if upheld); results tentatively 01-06-2026
admits_into: First-year admission (via counselling) into: (i) Engineering, Bio-Technology, B.Tech.(Dairy Technology), B.Tech.(Agr. Engg.), B.Tech.(Food Science & Technology); (ii) B.Sc.(Ag)/B.Sc.(Hort)/B.V.Sc.&A.H/B.F.Sc; (iii) B.Pharmacy, Pharm.D - at Government and private colleges across Andhra Pradesh for academic year 2026-27. Exam pattern: Computer-Based Test, objective/multiple-choice, 1 mark/question, no negative marking, bilingual English/Telugu. Engineering stream: 160 questions - Maths 80, Physics 40, Chemistry 40. Agriculture & Pharmacy stream: 160 questions - Biology 80 (Botany 40 + Zoology 40), Physics 40, Chemistry 40. Official mock test available at cets.apsche.ap.gov.in
source: APEAPCET-2026 Instruction Booklet (Engineering), V4, conducted by JNTU Kakinada on behalf of APSCHE: cets.apsche.ap.gov.in/EAPCET/PDF/APEAPCET2026_Instruction_Booklet_Engineering_V4.pdf - downloaded directly, rendered to page images with Poppler, and read in full (Important Dates table + eligibility + pattern all transcribed from the primary document). Cross-checked against two other official 2026 PDFs on the same portal: APEAPCET2026_Corrections_V2.pdf (helpdesk helpdeskapeapcet@apsche.org) and APEAPCET2026_ImportantInstructions.pdf (session-timing/conduct rules)
conducting_body: JNTU Kakinada on behalf of APSCHE
exam_pattern: Computer-based, 3 hours, 160 multiple-choice questions of 1 mark each: 80 Mathematics, 40 Physics, 40 Chemistry (Engineering stream). No negative marking. Ranks: 75% weightage to normalised EAPCET marks and 25% to Intermediate group-subject marks.

full_form_body: AP Engineering Common Entrance Test for Diploma Holders and for B.Sc. (with Mathematics as one of the optional subjects) Degree Holders - APECET 2026, conducted by JNTU Anantapur on behalf of APSCHE, for the academic year 2026-27
eligibility: Indian national, Andhra Pradesh local/non-local status per AP Government orders 2026-27; Diploma in Engineering/Technology/Pharmacy from the AP State Board of Technical Education (or an AICTE-approved equivalent), OR a 3-year B.Sc degree with Mathematics as one of the subjects; minimum 45% marks (40% for BC/SC/ST); candidates still pursuing a diploma are eligible if it completes before admission; B.Sc-stream candidates are considered for lateral seats only after diploma holders are exhausted
application_window: Notification 04.02.2026 (Wed); online applications 04.02.2026 - 12.03.2026 (no late fee); late fee tiers Rs.1,000 to 16.03.2026, Rs.2,000 to 20.03.2026, Rs.4,000 to 24.03.2026, Rs.10,000 to 28.03.2026; application-data correction window 29.03.2026
exam_date: 23.04.2026 (Thursday). Hall tickets from 09.04.2026; preliminary answer key released 27.04.2026 5PM, objection deadline 29.04.2026 5PM (Rs.300/objection, refundable if upheld); result 07.05.2026
admits_into: Lateral entry into 2nd year B.E./B.Tech and B.Pharmacy at AP university engineering colleges and AICTE-approved private institutions (10% over and above sanctioned intake); B.Sc(Maths)-stream candidates eligible for relevant courses per the official annexure, after diploma holders. Exam pattern: 200 marks/200 objective questions - Engineering stream: Maths 50 + Physics 25 + Chemistry 25 + branch-specific subject 100 (separate paper per branch: Civil/EEE/Mech/ECE/CSE/Chemical/Metallurgical/Mining/EIE/Ceramic Tech/Biotech/Agricultural Engg); Pharmacy stream: Pharmaceutics/Pharmaceutical Chemistry/Pharmacognosy/Pharmacology, 50 each; B.Sc(Maths) stream: Maths 100 + Analytical Ability 50 + Communicative English 50
source: Official APECET-2026 Instruction Booklet (JNTU Anantapur, on behalf of APSCHE): cets.apsche.ap.gov.in/ECET/PDF/APECET2026_InstructionBooklet_V6.pdf - fetched, rendered to page images with Poppler, and read directly (all fields above transcribed from the primary document, not a secondary tracker)
conducting_body: JNTU Anantapur on behalf of APSCHE
exam_pattern: Computer-based, 200 objective questions, 200 marks. Engineering: Mathematics 50, Physics 25, Chemistry 25, branch Engineering paper 100. Pharmacy: four sections of 50 marks. B.Sc (Maths): Mathematics 100, Analytical Ability 50, Communicative English 50.

full_form_body: Andhra Pradesh Integrated Common Entrance Test - conducted by APSCHE for admission to MBA and MCA programmes. Distinct from Telangana's TS ICET (icet.tgche.ac.in), which is a separate exam run by a different state body
eligibility: Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognised university (this primary document gives dates only; exact minimum-marks/reservation particulars not yet found in a machine-read instruction booklet - confirm on the official portal before relying on it for edge cases)
application_window: Notification published in newspapers 04-02-2026; online applications 05-02-2026 - 02-03-2026 (no late fee); late fee tiers Rs.1,000 (03-07 Mar), Rs.2,000 (08-12 Mar), Rs.4,000 (13-17 Mar), Rs.10,000 (18-21 Mar 2026); application corrections 23-03-2026; hall tickets from 15-04-2026 - CORRECTS an earlier pending_review entry that (via a secondary source) claimed the 2026 notification had not yet been released
exam_date: 02-05-2026, two sessions (09:00AM-11:30AM and 02:00PM-04:30PM). Preliminary key 05-05-2026 5PM; objection deadline 07-05-2026 5PM (Rs.300/objection, refundable if upheld); results & ranks declared 16-05-2026
admits_into: MBA and MCA postgraduate admission at AP colleges via APSCHE counselling for academic year 2026-27
source: APICET-2026 Important Dates notice, official portal: cets.apsche.ap.gov.in/ICET/PDF/APICET2026_ImportantDates.pdf - downloaded directly, rendered to a page image with Poppler, and read in full (the complete 14-row dates table above is transcribed from this primary document). An instruction booklet with granular eligibility/minimum-marks detail was not located by filename search this pass, so eligibility above stays partly secondary-sourced
conducting_body: Andhra University, Visakhapatnam (on behalf of APSCHE)
exam_pattern: Computer-based, 150 minutes, 200 questions of 1 mark each: Analytical Ability 75, Communication Ability 70, Mathematical Ability 55. No negative marking. Section B in English only; Sections A and C in English and Telugu.

full_form_body: National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (Undergraduate) - conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA) under the National Medical Commission (NMC)
eligibility: Passed Intermediate/Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology/Biotechnology. Minimum marks: 50% General, 40% OBC/SC/ST, 45% General-PwD, 40% OBC/SC/ST-PwD. Minimum age 17 by 31 Dec of admission year; no upper age limit
application_window: 2026 cycle registration closed 11 Mar 2026 (extended deadline). NEET UG 2027 notification not yet released as of Sept 2026 - NTA is expected to open registration alongside the info bulletin around Feb 2027
exam_date: Originally scheduled 3 May 2026; re-examination officially ordered by NTA (Public Notice, 15 May 2026, in continuation of a 12 May 2026 press release) and held 21 June 2026 (Sunday), Pen & Paper offline mode, 02:00 PM-05:15 PM IST including formalities, in 13 languages (Assamese, Bengali, English, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu). No fee/re-registration required; candidates could update city choice 15-21 May 2026. Results declared 16 July 2026: ~20 lakh appeared, 11.21 lakh qualified, 58%+ women among qualifiers. NEET UG 2027 notification not yet released as of this check (Sept 2026)
admits_into: MBBS, BDS, AYUSH courses (BAMS/BHMS/BUMS/BSMS), BVSc & AH, and B.Sc Nursing admission at Government and private medical/dental/AYUSH colleges nationwide, including AP
source: Two official NTA (neet.nta.nic.in) documents fetched directly and read: (1) Public Notice dated 15 May 2026 'Conduct of Re-examination for NEET (UG) 2026' (cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/.../2026/05/20260515960654684.pdf) - confirms re-exam date/timing/mode/languages; (2) Press Release dated 16 July 2026 'NTA Declares Result of NEET (UG) 2026' (cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/.../2026/07/20260716477215762.pdf) - confirms results date and qualifying figures. Both on NTA's official government CDN, not a secondary tracker
exam_pattern: Pen and paper (OMR), 3 hours, 180 compulsory multiple-choice questions, 720 marks: Physics 45, Chemistry 45, Biology (Botany & Zoology) 90. +4 for a correct answer, -1 for a wrong one, 0 if unanswered. 13 languages including Telugu.

full_form_body: Common Law Admission Test - conducted by the Consortium of National Law Universities (NLUs)
eligibility: Passed Class 12 (any stream, including CEC/HEC/MEC AP Intermediate students); specific minimum-marks criteria not detailed, verify on official notification
application_window: Online application portal open 3 August 2026 - 31 October 2026 (last date for submission)
exam_date: Sunday, 6 December 2026, 2:00 PM-4:00 PM, per the Consortium's Executive Committee/Governing Body decision at its 18 July 2026 meeting (offline, pen-and-paper mode)
admits_into: 5-year integrated law degrees (BA LLB, BBA LLB, B.Com LLB etc.) at 25 National Law Universities, GNLU Silvassa, IIULER Goa, and 60+ affiliated colleges nationwide
source: Official Press Release dated 22 July 2026 from the Consortium of National Law Universities (consortiumofnlus.ac.in/clat-2027/notifications/Press_Release_CLAT_2027.pdf) - fetched and read directly, real text PDF (not scanned), signed by the President, CNLUs
exam_pattern: 2 hours, 120 multiple-choice questions of 1 mark each, passage-based: English 22-26, Current Affairs & GK 28-32, Legal Reasoning 28-32, Logical Reasoning 22-26, Quantitative Techniques 10-14. 0.25 marks deducted for each wrong answer.

full_form_body: Chartered Accountancy Foundation course - conducted by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)
eligibility: Passed Class 12 (any stream) from a recognised board, or provisional registration while appearing for Class 12; no age restriction
application_window: Application window for the Sept-Nov 2026 cycle not itself in this notice; exam schedule announced 2 May 2026 (ICAI Important Announcement No. 13-CA(EXAM)/SEPTEMBER-NOVEMBER/2026). Next cycle's own application window not yet announced as of this check
exam_date: Foundation Course Examination: 2nd, 5th, 7th & 9th September 2026, per ICAI's official announcement. Papers 3 & 4 are 2 hours duration. (Intermediate: Group I 1/3/6 Sept, Group II 8/10/12 Sept; Final: Group I 2/4/6 Nov, Group II 9/11/13 Nov 2026, for reference)
admits_into: First step of the CA qualification: leads to CA Intermediate, then CA Final, then Chartered Accountant membership (ICAI) - a govt-regulated professional pathway parallel to a Commerce degree
source: Official ICAI Important Announcement No. 13-CA(EXAM)/SEPTEMBER-NOVEMBER/2026, dated 2 May 2026 (resource.cdn.icai.org/92035exam020526.pdf) - fetched directly and read as plain text (genuine text PDF, ICAI's own examination department letterhead)
conducting_body: Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)

full_form_body: Conducted by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC); training at the National Defence Academy (Army/Navy/Air Force wings) and Naval Academy
eligibility: Class 12 pass (any stream) for Army wing; Class 12 with Physics & Mathematics for Air Force/Navy wings. Age: born within a specific ~2-year window, max ~19.5 years. Unmarried; open to both male and female candidates
application_window: NDA & NA-II, 2026 (Examination Notice No.10/2026-NDA-II): notified 20.05.2026, online application deadline 09.06.2026 (via upsconline.nic.in). NDA & NA (I), 2027: notification due 02.12.2026, last date for applications 22.12.2026 (UPSC 2027 calendar)
exam_date: NDA & NA-II, 2026 written exam: 13.09.2026. NDA & NA (I), 2027 exam: 11.04.2027 (UPSC 2027 calendar)
admits_into: Written exam + SSB interview + medical/physical fitness tests, leading to training at NDA/Naval Academy and eventual commission as an officer in the Indian Army, Navy, or Air Force
source: Official UPSC Examination Notice No.10/2026-NDA-II (upsc.gov.in/sites/default/files/Notif-NDA-II-2026-Engl-200526.pdf) - fetched directly and read as plain text (a genuine text PDF, not scanned); UPSC Programme of Examinations 2027 (as on 20.05.2026): upsc.gov.in/sites/default/files/Calendar-Year-2027-Engl-200526.pdf
exam_pattern: Written: Mathematics (2½ hours, 300 marks) and General Ability Test (2½ hours, 600 marks), objective questions; one-third of a question's marks deducted for each wrong answer. Then the SSB test/interview (900 marks). Total 1,800. No calculators.

full_form_body: Common University Entrance Test (Undergraduate) - conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA)
eligibility: Passed Class 12 or appearing in the current year's board exam (any stream/board, including AP Intermediate); no age restriction
application_window: 2026 cycle registration (3-30 Jan 2026) is closed. CUET UG 2027 registration is expected to open in January 2027; NTA may release an advance exam calendar around Sep-Oct 2026 - not yet confirmed against the primary site
exam_date: Conducted 11-31 May 2026 AND 06-07 June 2026 (the June dates were an official reschedule for candidates hit by a technical glitch during the 30 May Shift-I sitting) - CBT mode, 321 examination cities including 15 abroad (Abu Dhabi, Doha, Dubai, Munich, Kathmandu, Kuala Lumpur, Kuwait City, Lagos, Manama, Muscat, Riyadh, Sharjah, Singapore, West Java, Washington). 15,68,867 registered, 11,64,098 appeared. Results declared 23 June 2026. CUET UG 2027 dates not yet officially announced
admits_into: Undergraduate admission across Central, State, Deemed, and Private Universities nationwide - 37 subjects on offer (13 languages + 23 domain-specific + 1 General Aptitude Test), candidates choose up to 5
source: Two official NTA (cuet.nta.nic.in) documents fetched directly and read: (1) Press Release dated 07 June 2026 'Successful Conduct of CUET (UG) 2026' (cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/.../2026/06/20260608323708178.pdf) - confirms full exam window, city count, subject structure; (2) Press Release dated 23 June 2026 'NTA Declares the Result/NTA Scores of CUET (UG) 2026' (cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/.../2026/06/20260623716111016.pdf) - confirms results date and registered/appeared figures

full_form_body: Joint Entrance Examination (Main) - conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA) for admission to NITs, IIITs, and other Centrally Funded Technical Institutions (CFTIs), and as the qualifying stage for JEE Advanced
eligibility: Passed Class 12 (Intermediate MPC in AP) in 2025, 2026, or appearing in 2027, with Physics, Chemistry, and Maths; no minimum-marks eligibility bar; maximum 3 consecutive attempts from the year of passing Class 12 (up to 2 sessions/year)
application_window: 2026-27 cycle notification/registration already ran (Session 1 ~Nov 2025, Session 2 ~Feb 2026, per NTA's published information bulletins). JEE Main 2027 registration not yet open as of this check (Sept 2026) - no official NTA notification for 2027 found
exam_date: JEE (Main) 2026, academic session 2026-27, CBT mode, 13 languages: Session 1 held 21, 22, 23, 24 & 28 January 2026 (10 shifts); Session 2 held 02, 04, 05, 06 & 08 April 2026 (9 shifts) at 584 centres in 319 cities incl. 15 abroad (Manama, Doha, Muscat, Riyadh, Sharjah, Singapore, Kuwait, Kuala Lumpur, Kathmandu, Abu Dhabi, West Java, Washington, Lagos, Munich, Dammam). Session 2 Paper 1 registered: 11,10,904 (7,56,976 male, 3,53,928 female). Results declared 20 April 2026. JEE Main 2027 dates not yet announced
admits_into: B.Tech/B.E. admission (outside the AP EAPCET state-quota system) at NITs, IIITs, and GFTIs nationwide; a JEE Main rank in the top ~2,50,000 also qualifies a candidate to sit JEE Advanced for IIT admission
source: Official NTA (jeemain.nta.nic.in) Press Release dated 20 April 2026, 'Declaration of the Result/NTA Scores for JEE (Main) - 2026 of Paper 1 (B.E./B.Tech.)' (cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/.../2026/04/20260420809492136.pdf) - fetched directly, rendered with Poppler, and read in full; confirms both session date ranges, city/centre counts, and registered-candidate breakdown
exam_pattern: Paper 1 (B.E./B.Tech): computer-based, 3 hours, 75 questions, 300 marks. Each of Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry has 20 multiple-choice and 5 numerical-answer questions. +4 for a correct answer, -1 for a wrong one in both sections. Two sessions (January and April); the better NTA score counts. 13 languages including Telugu.

full_form_body: Joint Entrance Examination (Advanced) - conducted by one IIT on a rotating basis each year (IIT Roorkee organised the 2026 edition; IIT Delhi is expected to organise 2027) for admission to the IITs
eligibility: Must rank among the top ~2,50,000 candidates in JEE Main of the same year; maximum 2 attempts, in 2 consecutive years
application_window: For the 2026 edition: online registration opened 23 April 2026, extended deadline 5 May 2026 (11:59 PM). JEE Advanced 2027 registration not yet open as of this check (Sept 2026)
exam_date: JEE (Advanced) 2026 held Sunday, 17 May 2026. Provisional answer keys 25 May 2026; final answer keys 1 June 2026; results on the JoSAA portal from 7 June 2026. Architecture Aptitude Test (AAT) held 4 June 2026, 9:00AM-12:00 noon, results 7 June 2026. 1,79,694 appeared, 56,880 qualified. JoSAA 2026 counselling ran 5 rounds through 24 July 2026 (withdrawal deadline 14 July 2026, 5PM). 2027 exam date not yet announced
admits_into: B.Tech and integrated undergraduate programmes at the 23 IITs nationwide
source: Official JEE Advanced site (jeeadv.ac.in), the exam's own organising-authority portal (IIT Roorkee for 2026) - fetched directly, quoting its own notices including "JEE (Advanced) 2026 will be held on Sunday, 17th May, 2026" and the JoSAA round deadlines table
exam_pattern: Two compulsory papers of 3 hours each on the same day (Paper 1 morning, Paper 2 afternoon), computer-based, each covering Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry. Only the top 2,50,000 JEE (Main) B.E./B.Tech candidates may register (10% GEN-EWS, 27% OBC-NCL, 15% SC, 7.5% ST, 40.5% open; 5% PwD within each). At most two attempts in consecutive years.

full_form_body: All India Entrance Examination for Admission - conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA) for the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR), covering PG and JRF-level agriculture admissions at ICAR-affiliated Central/State Agricultural Universities nationwide. Note: the UG-level AIEEA paper was discontinued and merged into CUET-UG (ICAR now uses CUET-UG scores for its UG agriculture-seat counselling), so this exam is now PG/JRF-only
eligibility: Bachelor's degree in the relevant agriculture/allied-science field from a recognised university, with the minimum OGPA/percentage ICAR sets each cycle
application_window: ICAR AIEEA (PG)-2026: online application 08 May 2026 - 07 June 2026 (up to 5PM), last date for fee payment 07 June 2026 (up to 11:50PM), correction window 09-10 June 2026. 2027 cycle window not yet announced as of this check
exam_date: 04 July 2026 (Saturday), single paper, 120 minutes (2 hours) duration. 2027 exam date not yet announced
admits_into: PG and JRF seats in agriculture and allied sciences (Agriculture, Horticulture, Forestry, Fisheries, Agricultural Engineering, etc.) at ICAR-affiliated universities nationwide - UG admission into these same universities now runs through CUET-UG rather than a separate AIEEA UG paper
source: Official NTA Information Bulletin for ICAR AIEEA (PG)-2026 (cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s388a839f2f6f1427879fc33ee4acf4f66/uploads/2026/05/202605091397132773.pdf, exams.nta.nic.in/icar/) - fetched directly and read as plain text (genuine text PDF); confirms the full 'Important Information and Dates at a Glance' table

full_form_body: Air Force Common Admission Test - conducted twice a year by the Indian Air Force for Group 'A' Gazetted Officer entry into the Flying Branch and Ground Duty (Technical and Non-Technical) branches, plus NCC Special Entry and GATE Score Entry
eligibility: Indian citizen; unmarried at the start of the course. Age (AFCAT 02/2026, as on 01 Jul 2027): Flying Branch 20-24 years (born 02 Jul 2003 - 01 Jul 2007; up to 26 with a valid DGCA Commercial Pilot Licence); Ground Duty Technical & Non-Technical 20-26 years (born 02 Jul 2001 - 01 Jul 2007). Flying: passed Maths and Physics at 10+2 AND a 3-year degree in any discipline, or BE/B.Tech, or AMIE/AeSI Sections A & B. Ground Duty (Technical) AE(L)/AE(M): Physics and Maths at 10+2 plus a 4-year engineering degree in the listed disciplines. Full branch-wise rules in the notification
application_window: AFCAT 02/2026: online applications 20 May 2026 (1100 hrs) to 19 Jun 2026 (2330 hrs) at afcat.edcil.co.in; fee Rs 550 + 18% GST (no fee for NCC Special/GATE entries). Results declared; AFSB slot selection ran 10-14 Sep 2026. AFCAT 01/2027 notification not yet released as of 04 Oct 2026 - no date announced
exam_date: AFCAT 02/2026: online exam held 08 Aug 2026 (Saturday). Pattern: 100 objective questions, 300 marks, 2 hours, English only; General Awareness, Verbal Ability in English, Numerical Ability, Reasoning & Military Aptitude; +3 per correct answer, -1 per wrong answer. AFCAT 01/2027 exam date not yet announced
admits_into: Commission as a Group 'A' officer in the Indian Air Force (Flying, Ground Duty Technical AE(L)/AE(M), Ground Duty Non-Technical) after AFSB testing and medicals; courses commencing July 2027 for the 02/2026 cycle. 379 tentative vacancies in AFCAT 02/2026
source: Official AFCAT 02/2026 Notification (Indian Air Force), downloaded from the official AFCAT portal: afcat.edcil.co.in/assets/images/news/AFCAT_02_2026/Notification for AFCAT Cycle 02-2026.pdf (also published at careerairforce.gov.in). Results/AFSB status from the afcat.edcil.co.in home page, checked 04 Oct 2026
exam_pattern: Online, 2 hours, 100 objective questions, 300 marks, English only. +3 for each correct answer, -1 for each wrong answer, 0 for unattempted. Numerical Ability at Class 10 level; other sections at graduation level.

full_form_body: Conducted by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC), twice yearly, for officer entry into the Indian Military Academy (IMA), Indian Naval Academy (INA), Air Force Academy (AFA), and Officers' Training Academy (OTA) after graduation
eligibility: Bachelor's degree (an Engineering degree is required for technical entries to IMA/INA/AFA); age typically 19-24 years depending on academy/wing; IMA/INA/AFA entry requires candidates to be unmarried, OTA (Short Service Commission) entry has separate criteria and does not require an engineering degree
application_window: CDS-II, 2026 (Examination Notice No.11/2026-CDS-II): notified 20.05.2026, online application deadline 09.06.2026 (via upsconline.nic.in). CDS (I), 2027: notification due 02.12.2026, last date for applications 22.12.2026 (UPSC 2027 calendar)
exam_date: CDS-II, 2026 written exam: 13.09.2026 (same day as NDA & NA-II, 2026 - UPSC conducts both together). CDS (I), 2027 exam: 11.04.2027 (UPSC 2027 calendar)
admits_into: Written exam + SSB interview + medical tests, leading to officer training at IMA/INA/AFA (Permanent Commission) or OTA (Short Service Commission), then commissioning into the Indian Army, Navy, or Air Force
source: Official UPSC Examination Notice No.11/2026-CDS-II (upsc.gov.in/sites/default/files/Notif-CDS-II-2026-Engl-200526.pdf) - fetched directly and read as plain text (a genuine text PDF, not scanned); UPSC Programme of Examinations 2027 (as on 20.05.2026): upsc.gov.in/sites/default/files/Calendar-Year-2027-Engl-200526.pdf
exam_pattern: Written, objective, 2 hours per paper: English, General Knowledge and Elementary Mathematics (100 marks each) for IMA, INA and AFA; English and General Knowledge only for OTA. Written and interview marks are equal: 300 each for IMA/INA/AFA, 200 each for OTA. Negative marking for wrong answers.

full_form_body: National Aptitude Test in Architecture - conducted by the Council of Architecture (CoA) across multiple test-window sessions each cycle
eligibility: Class 12 pass (or appearing) with Physics, Chemistry, and Maths (PCM), or a 3-year Diploma with Maths; no upper age limit. NOT YET PRIMARY-VERIFIED: minimum PCM aggregate percentage was not confirmed on nata.in's homepage during this check (brochure PDF not fetched this pass) - re-verify the exact cutoff on nata.in before relying on it
application_window: NATA 2026: online form fill-up from 9 March 2026 onwards; registration for specific sessions from 4 April 2026 onwards (weekly closing dates, generally Mon/Tue 11:59PM ahead of each Fri/Sat session). NATA 2027 registration not yet open as of this check (Sept 2026)
exam_date: Phase 1: every Friday & Saturday from 04.04.2026 to 13.06.2026 (except public holidays) - Friday afternoon session 1:30-4:30PM only, Saturday morning 10AM-1PM and afternoon 1:30-4:30PM. Phase 2 (single-attempt window for those who missed Phase 1): 7-8 August 2026. NATA 2027 dates not yet released
admits_into: B.Arch admission (5-year programme) at Council of Architecture-recognised colleges nationwide, including AP; some institutes alternatively accept a JEE Main Paper 2 score instead of/alongside NATA
source: Official Council of Architecture site nata.in, fetched directly - quotes its own published schedule ("Every Friday & Saturday From 04.04.2026 to 13.06.2026 (Phase 1)", "On August 7 & 8, 2026 (Phase 2)"). Eligibility minimum-marks figure still not primary-confirmed - see caveat above

exam_name: TG EAPCET (Telangana State Engineering, Agriculture & Pharmacy Common Entrance Test)
full_form_body: Telangana Engineering, Agriculture and Pharmacy Common Entrance Test - conducted by Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University Hyderabad (JNTUH) on behalf of the Telangana Council of Higher Education (TGCHE)
eligibility: Indian national / PIO / OCI; must meet Telangana local/non-local status rules. Engineering: passed or appearing Intermediate (10+2) with Maths, Physics and Chemistry/Biotechnology/Biology, or a Telangana SBTET Diploma in Engineering; minimum 45% in MPC/BiPC taken together (40% for reserved categories); at least 16 years old on 31 Dec of the admission year, no upper age limit. Agriculture/Horticulture/BVSc/BFSc and some B.Tech (Dairy/Ag Engg/Food Tech): 17 years minimum, upper age 22 (25 for SC/ST)
application_window: 2026: online applications 19 Feb 2026 to 04 Apr 2026 without late fee; late fee Rs 250 to 10 Apr, Rs 500 to 15 Apr, Rs 2,500 to 20 Apr, Rs 5,000 to 24 Apr, Rs 10,000 up to 02 May 2026. Fee Rs 500 (SC/ST/PH) or Rs 900 (others) per stream; Rs 1,000 / Rs 1,800 for both streams. Ranks released 17 May 2026. 2027 notification not yet released as of 04 Oct 2026

exam_name: TS ICET (Telangana State Integrated Common Entrance Test)

conducting_body: Mahatma Gandhi University, Nalgonda on behalf of TGCHE

eligibility: Students studying Class X in a recognised school in Andhra Pradesh during 2026-27 (SSC Public Examinations 2027)

full_form_body: Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya Selection Test for Class 6 admission
eligibility: Bona fide resident of the district studying in Class V in 2026-27 at a recognised school in that district; born between 01.05.2015 and 31.07.2017 (both inclusive); must have studied the full academic session of Classes III, IV and V
application_window: JNVST 2027: online application (free) on navodaya.gov.in; last date 31 July 2026 (closed)

exam_pattern: Pen and paper (OMR), 2 hours, 80 objective questions for 100 marks, 1.25 marks each, no negative marking: Mental Ability 20 + Environmental Studies 20 (50 marks, 60 min), Arithmetic 20 (25 marks, 30 min), Language 20 (25 marks, 30 min). Extra 40 minutes for Divyang students. Written in the student's chosen language/medium.

eligibility: Class 6: aged 10-12 on 31 March 2026 (born 01 Apr 2014 - 31 Mar 2016); girls eligible. Class 9: aged 13-15 (born 01 Apr 2011 - 31 Mar 2013); girls eligible subject to vacancies. Ages as on 31 March 2026

full_form_body: National Standard Examination in Junior Science, first stage of the Junior Science Olympiad (up to Class 10)
eligibility: Indian passport-eligible; born between 1 Jan 2012 and 31 Dec 2013; living and studying in India (or in the Indian school system) since 30 Nov 2024; must not have completed the Class 10 board exam before 30 Nov 2026; must not write NSEA/NSEB/NSEC/NSEP 2026

source: IAPT NSE 2026 Students' Brochure: iapt.org.in/wp-content/uploads/NSE-2026-Student-Brochure.pdf
exam_pattern: 2 hours, 216 marks: 48 multiple-choice questions (+3, -1) and 12 questions with one or more correct options (6 marks, all correct options needed). Class 10 CBSE level, Biology, Chemistry and Physics with equal emphasis. Paper in English, Hindi, Gujarati, Bangla, Kannada, Tamil and Telugu.

Biological Sciences), English and five subjects in all; at least 75% aggregate in PCM/PCB AND at least 60% in each of the three (74.9% is not rounded up). full_form_body: Undergraduate Common Entrance Examination for Design
eligibility: Passed Class 12 (or equivalent) in 2026 or appearing in 2027, in ANY stream (Science, Commerce or Arts & Humanities). Born on or after 1 Oct 2002 (OPEN/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 1 Oct 1997 (SC/ST/PwD). At most two attempts, in consecutive years
application_window: UCEED 2027: online registration 01-31 Oct 2026 (OPEN as of 04 Oct 2026); with Rs 500 late fee to 06 Nov 2026 (5 pm). Fee Rs 2,000 for women and SC/ST/PwD, Rs 4,000 for others
exam_date: 17 Jan 2027 (Sunday), 9:00 AM - 12:00 noon. Admit cards from 01 Jan 2027; results 06 Mar 2027; B.Des applications from 15 Mar 2027
admits_into: B.Des at IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, IIT Guwahati, IIT Hyderabad, IIT Indore, IIT Roorkee and IIITDM Jabalpur (apply separately after qualifying); many other design schools accept UCEED scores

Part A (computer-based, 200 marks, 2 hours): 14 numerical-answer questions (4 marks, no negative), 15 multiple-select questions (up to 4 marks with partial marks, -1 if wrong), 28 multiple-choice questions (3 marks, -0.71 if wrong). exam_pattern: Aptitude test, then personal interview for shortlisted candidates.

eligibility: 3-year LL.B.: a graduate degree (10+2+3) with 45% aggregate (42% BC, 40% SC/ST), or a PG degree with the same percentage. 5-year LL.B.: Intermediate (10+2) with 45% (42% BC, 40% SC/ST). 44.5%, 41.5% and 39.5% are treated as 45%, 42% and 40%

exam_pattern: Computer-based, 90 minutes, 120 questions of 1 mark: Part A General Knowledge and Mental Ability 30, Part B Current Affairs 30, Part C Aptitude for the Study of Law 60.

full_form_body: Andhra Pradesh Education Common Entrance Test for the 2-year B.Ed course, conducted by Dravidian University on behalf of APSCHE
eligibility: Indian national meeting AP local/non-local rules; at least 19 years old on 1 July 2026, no upper age limit. application_window: 2026: registration from 11 Feb 2026 (APSCHE notification). 2027 notification not yet released as of 04 Oct 2026

exam_pattern: Computer-based, 2 hours. Part A General English, Part B General Knowledge and Teaching Aptitude, Part C one methodology subject at degree level (Mathematics, Physical Sciences, Biological Sciences, Social Studies or English).

eligibility: Meets Telangana local/non-local rules; any bachelor's degree (B.A, B.Com, B.Sc, B.Sc Home Science, BCA, BBM, BBA, B.A Oriental Languages) or a master's degree with at least 50% aggregate, or B.E/B.Tech with 50%; SC/ST/BC and other reserved categories 40%. admits_into: 2-year B.Ed in colleges of education in Telangana for 2026-27
source: TG Ed.CET-2026 Information Booklet and Revised Schedule (Kakatiya University, Warangal for TGCHE): edcet.tgche.ac.in/Documents/Information Booklet of TG EdCET-2026.pdf, .../Schedule.pdf
exam_pattern: Computer-based, 2 hours, 150 multiple-choice questions of 1 mark. Paper in English-Telugu or English-Urdu.

conducting_body: Andhra University, Visakhapatnam (on behalf of APSCHE)

application_window: 2026: notification and applications from 15 May 2026; last date without late fee 15 Jun 2026; Rs 500 late fee to 17 Jun, Rs 2,000 to 19 Jun 2026. Fee Rs 800 (OC/BC), Rs 600 (SC/ST/PH), Rs 450 per extra subject. 2027 notification not yet released as of 04 Oct 2026

admits_into: PG and PG diploma courses in campus, constituent and affiliated colleges of the nine participating universities, through web-based counselling

full_form_body: Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering, for M.Tech admissions and PSU recruitment
eligibility: Students in the 3rd or higher year of any undergraduate degree, or graduates of any government-approved degree in Engineering, Technology, Architecture, Science, Commerce, Arts or Humanities; also holders of approved professional-society qualifications (IE, IETE, AeSI and others). application_window: GATE 2027: registration opened 02 Sep 2026; regular registration extended to 05 Oct 2026; with late fee to 12 Oct 2026 (OPEN as of 04 Oct 2026); application corrections 14-21 Oct 2026

source: GATE 2027 official website (IIT Madras, organising institute): gate2027.iitm.ac.in - Important Dates, Eligibility Criteria, Question Paper Pattern (checked 04 Oct 2026)
conducting_body: IISc and the IITs for the National Coordination Board, Ministry of Education; organised in 2027 by IIT Madras
exam_pattern: Computer-based, 3 hours, English, 65 questions for 100 marks: General Aptitude 10 questions (15 marks) + 55 subject questions (85 marks, including 13 marks of Engineering Mathematics in most engineering papers). MCQ, multiple-select and numerical-answer questions of 1 or 2 marks; 1/3 or 2/3 mark deducted for a wrong MCQ, no negative marking for MSQ/NAT. 30 test papers (new: Robotics and Automation); up to two papers allowed.

full_form_body: Common Admission Test for IIM MBA programmes
eligibility: Bachelor's degree with at least 50% marks or equivalent CGPA (45% for SC, ST and PwBD), or a professional qualification (CA/CS/CMA/FIAI) with the same percentage; final-year students may apply and join provisionally. Each IIM sets its own further cut-offs
application_window: CAT 2026: registration 03 Aug - 22 Sep 2026, 5:00 PM (closed; extended from 15 Sep). Fee Rs 1,350 (SC/ST/PwBD), Rs 2,700 (others)
exam_date: 29 Nov 2026 (Sunday), computer-based, three sessions, about 170 test cities; admit cards from 04 Nov 2026; results expected first week of January 2027 (score valid to 31 Dec 2027)
admits_into: Management programmes (PGP/MBA and others) at the 22 IIMs, including IIM Visakhapatnam, and many non-IIM institutes that use CAT scores
source: CAT 2026 Information Bulletin (26-07-2026, V2) and Eligibility note: cdn.digialm.com/per/g06/pub/32842/EForms/image/CAT2026/CAT2026InformationBulletin_26-07-2026_V2.pdf; dates and FAQs on iimcat.ac.in
exam_pattern: Computer-based, 2 hours, three sections answered in a fixed order: Verbal Ability & Reading Comprehension; Data Interpretation & Logical Reasoning; Quantitative Ability. MCQs: +3 correct, -1 wrong. Typed-answer (non-MCQ) questions: +3 correct, no negative marking. On-screen calculator; no fixed syllabus. PwBD candidates get 40 extra minutes.

full_form_body: Civil Services Examination for IAS, IPS, IFS and other central services
eligibility: A graduate degree from a recognised university (final-year students may apply). Age 21-32 on 1 August of the exam year (CSE 2026: born 2 Aug 1994 - 1 Aug 2005); upper age relaxed by 5 years for SC/ST, 3 for OBC, and for ex-servicemen and PwBD. Attempts: 6 for General/EWS, 9 for OBC and PwBD (General/EWS/OBC), unlimited for SC/ST
application_window: CSE 2026: notice 04 Feb 2026, last date 24 Feb 2026 (closed). CSE 2027: notification due 13 Jan 2027, last date 02 Feb 2027 (UPSC 2027 calendar)
exam_date: CSE 2026 Prelims held 24 May 2026; Mains 2026 in progress. CSE 2027 Prelims: 23 May 2027 (UPSC calendar)
admits_into: IAS, IPS, IFS (Foreign Service) and other Group A and B central civil services; about 933 vacancies in CSE 2026
source: UPSC Examination Notice No. 05/2026-CSE (04.02.2026): upsc.gov.in/sites/default/files/Notif-CSP-2026-Engl-060226Rev.pdf; UPSC Programme of Examinations 2027: upsc.gov.in/sites/default/files/Calendar-Year-2027-Engl-200526.pdf
exam_pattern: Three stages. Prelims (objective): GS Paper I 200 marks and GS Paper II (CSAT) 200 marks, 2 hours each; Paper II is qualifying at 33%, ranking by Paper I. Mains (written): qualifying papers in an Indian language and English (300 each), then Essay, GS I-IV and two optional-subject papers (250 each) = 1,750 marks. Personality Test (interview): 275 marks. Final merit out of 2,025.

full_form_body: APPSC Group-I Services recruitment (Deputy Collector, DSP and other gazetted posts)
eligibility: A bachelor's degree from a recognised university (B.E./B.Tech in ECE/Telecom/Radio Engineering for one post; physical standards for police posts). Age limits and community details are in the detailed notification, due on psc.ap.gov.in on or before 06 Oct 2026
application_window: Online at psc.ap.gov.in from 06 Oct to 27 Oct 2026 (11:59 PM); One Time Profile Registration (OTPR) needed first
exam_date: Screening test (offline, OMR) date to be announced
admits_into: Group-I posts such as Deputy Collector, Assistant Commissioner of State Tax, Deputy Superintendent of Police, Accounts Officer (Treasury), District Employment Officer, Assistant Audit Officer and Divisional Development Officer
source: APPSC Brief Notification No. 07/2026 (15/09/2026), Group-I Services: psc.ap.gov.in/Documents/NotificationDocuments/Group_I_072026.pdf (from portal-psc.ap.gov.in Recruitment Notifications)
exam_pattern: Screening test (objective, degree standard; 1/3 mark deducted per wrong answer): Paper I General Studies (120 questions, 120 marks, 120 minutes: history and culture; constitution, polity, social justice and international relations; Indian and AP economy and planning; geography) and Paper II General Aptitude (120 questions, 120 marks: mental ability, administrative and psychological abilities; science and technology; current events). Mains (descriptive, 3 hours each): Telugu and English papers (qualifying, 150 each) plus five papers of 150 marks: General Essay; History, Culture and Geography of India and AP; Polity, Constitution, Governance, Law and Ethics; Economy and Development of India and AP; Science, Technology and Environment. Interview 75 marks. Total 825.

TGPSC Group-I Services recruitment
eligibility: A bachelor's degree (some posts need specific degrees). 2024 cycle: age 18-46 on 01.07.2024 for most posts (21 minimum for some; uniformed posts have their own limits and physical standards); upper age relaxed for SC/ST/BC and others

exam_date: Not announced; watch tgpsc.gov.in for the next Group-II notification

source: TSPSC (now TGPSC) Notification No. 28/2022, Group-II Services, with Annexure-III Scheme and Syllabus: websitenew.tgpsc.gov.in/directRecruitment (latest Group-II notification listed as of 05 Oct 2026)

exam_date: Next cycle not yet announced

source: TGPSC Notification No. 19/2022, Group-IV Services, Annexure-III scheme and syllabus (from websitenew.tgpsc.gov.in/notifications); no newer Group-IV notification listed as of 04 Oct 2026

In English, Telugu and Urdu.
